adopt.pattern: Support AgentStream (WebSocket bidirectional, 8 kHz PCM, mark/clear for barge-in) as a bring-your-own-carrier path from day one, via the existing Pipecat ExotelFrameSerializer
adopt.evidence: EXO-12, EXO-V05, decision.2026-10-20.exotel-rails-not-rival-in-ux; Exotel publishes guides for 9+ rival platforms (EXO-28); ElevenLabs native Exotel provider since 2026-06-01.

adopt.pattern: Locked platform safety layer above the editable prompt, plus a Mask Sensitive Data toggle, bounded silence nudges that end the call, and a max-duration setting
